_note: M4 V4: targets and rewards (docs/M4_VARIETY.md section 8). Targets live on the PC (Targets app) until the V5 map. kinds = the rules per building type: time (a night 'action' or the whole 'night'), shut (nights closed after a hit), heat (Krall nights), destroy (can be burned with a door charge), solo (a one-person job), crates (loot crates inside), loot (what can be in a crate: weighted), good_rooms (where the best crate sits). Loot entries use DepotRun.grant types (material, supply, gear, blueprint, upgrade) plus intel and money. Raid loot never gets too crazy: the strongest and wackiest gear comes from crafting (user 2026-11-26). Text is a generated baseline the user expands on. Numbers are first guesses.

lines: You know where it is. Nothing about the inside.
You know the rooms and the ways in. Not who's there.
You know the guards and their hours. Probably not all of them.
You know where the good stuff is. Still not everything.

fixed.name: CENTRAL POLICE HQ
fixed.line: The district's police headquarters. Always there, always manned.
The metal works. Rare alloys for the army go out of here.
The relay mast. Every state broadcast in the district goes through it.

fixed.name: KESSEL ROAD: DEPUTY VASS
fixed.line: Deputy Vass drives through the Kessel Road roadblock. One chance.

loot.name: tab_book_%d.txt
loot.worth: Who drinks here on whose money.
loot.label: a tab book

loot.name: private_file_%d.txt
loot.worth: An official's private file. Enough to lean on them.
loot.label: a private file

loot.name: building_plans_%d.pdf
loot.worth: Floor plans of a state building.
loot.label: building plans

loot.label: blank IDs and stamps

loot.name: duty_roster_%d.txt
loot.worth: Who's on, who's off, at another post.
loot.label: the duty roster

loot.name: shipping_orders_%d.txt

loot.label: shipping orders

an old manual with a recipe in it

loot.worth: Who reads what. The Bureau keeps the same list.
loot.label: lending cards

watch.line: You spend the evening across the street, watching %s.

tip_lines: Someone on Nod: "%s on %s. They keep something in the back nobody's supposed to see."
A follower writes: "My cousin cleans at %s on %s. Hardly anyone there after dark."
Nod post, already deleted: "%s, %s. Ask yourselves who's paying for it."

chair.tip_line: "%s on %s. Go see for yourself. Don't say it was me."
chair.inside_line: "Where they keep the good stuff at %s? The %s."

fixer.name: THE FIXER
fixer.who: A man with a market stall and three phones.
fixer.gives: Money for anything. Opens the Lantern black market.

jobs.line: A bar owner owes me. Take his till and his tab book.
An office has papers I can sell twice.

favour.name: Make a call
favour.line: He makes a call. The Bureau looks somewhere else for a while.

reporters.name: THE LAMP
reporters.who: An underground paper run off a church copier.
reporters.gives: Followers and mood. They print what you bring.

stock.line: A reporter's notes on a target (+1 knowing)

jobs.line: We need proof. The records room, the files with names in them.
The police post keeps a list of who they took. Get it.

favour.name: Print a story
favour.line: The front page names the men who run the district. The street warms to you.

weapons.name: THE FOUNDRY BOYS
weapons.who: Old steelworkers who never handed in their rifles.
weapons.gives: Guns, mags and blueprints for the gun bench.

jobs.line: The gun shop sells to the militia. Empty its back store.
Their armory. That's all we want.

favour.name: Lend a man
favour.line: They lend you one of theirs for three nights. He knows what he's doing.

hackers.name: NINTH LAMP
hackers.who: Kids with a server in a flooded basement.

stock.line: They pull a target's floor plan (+1 knowing)

jobs.line: The mast's codebook. Bring it and we own the airwaves for a night.
A records room with the names of informants.

favour.name: Pull everything
favour.line: They pull everything on one target: you know the inside.

aid.name: THE CANAL SISTERS
aid.who: Nurses who run a clinic nobody is supposed to know about.
aid.gives: Treatment, med blueprints, and people who need somewhere to go.

jobs.line: The state clinic hoards what we need. Bring the dispensary.

favour.name: Take the hurt
favour.line: They take your wounded for the night. Everyone comes back patched.
